summary: Proceed with another falsification round, but change both the observation channel and the evaluation design before changing the planner. Keep MCTS, bi-level search, and StoryBox/risk-list reconnection held. The next gate is native public-vote visibility plus paired cross-play against fixed baselines, with empirically calibrated evidence on held-out seeds.

Q1.decision: The reconstructed public-vote-record arm is legitimate only as a clearly labelled sensitivity arm, not as the primary benchmark. Replace it for the next primary diagnostic with a native TextArena-compatible vote encoding if verified.
Q1.reason: SecretMafia explicitly calls _record_vote(..., broadcast_to_all=True) for day votes, so the environment intends the submitted vote action to be public. State.add_observation strips strings matching role tags such as '[Player N]' from PLAYER_ACTION observations. SecretMafia's VoteHandler accepts both '[Player N]' and '[N]'. Therefore the cleanest falsification test is to submit '[N]' and verify that the target survives the normal observation pipeline. This preserves environment semantics without reconstructing information out of band.
Q1.required_test: Add an integration test against textarena 0.7.4 showing that a day vote submitted as '[N]' is received by later eligible actors through the ordinary public observation stream with target N intact, while no backstage state is read. If this fails, keep the reconstructed channel sensitivity-only and document why.

Q2.decision: Yes. All-seats self-play must be demoted from the primary strength test. Add paired mixed-population/cross-play evaluation.
Q2.reason: When every seat uses the same policy, faction win rate is a property of a policy playing against itself and cannot answer whether an informed policy is stronger than a fixed uninformed opponent. It also confounds asymmetric benefits and harms across Village and Mafia.
Q2.required_design: Use shared seeds and identical role schedules. At minimum run: informed Village seats vs fixed baseline Mafia; baseline Village vs informed Mafia; then swap belief and belief_planning. Prefer a small cross-play matrix over a single mixed table. Keep self-play as a stability/exploitability diagnostic, not the headline acceptance metric.

Q3.decision: Hold step E, MCTS, bi-level search, and StoryBox/risk-list reconnection.
Q3.reason: The current planner has not been shown to improve strategic outcomes when its belief mechanism actually engages. Adding search depth on top of a mis-specified evidence model can amplify the defect. Reconnecting to the peaceful narrative world would inject an unvalidated cognition component into the system.
Q3.lift_condition: Only reconsider after a fixed-opponent cross-play experiment shows a reproducible gain attributable to belief/planning rather than tie-breaking or channel artifacts, and mechanism diagnostics remain healthy.

Q4.decision: Do not add another hand-tuned accusatory likelihood table first. Build a minimal symmetric evidence feature set and replay-calibrate it on training seeds, then evaluate on held-out seeds.
Q4.reason: Round 5 already falsified the hand-specified direction of the vote evidence. Adding hand-coded accusatory terms risks replacing one author bias with another. The next evidence model should estimate likelihood ratios from replay data, with smoothing and an explicit train/eval split. Candidate vote features may include target identity, same-target coordination, timing/bandwagon position, and persistence/switching, but include only features observable to the actor at that decision point.
Q4.required_falsification: Fit/calibrate on one seed partition and freeze the model before evaluating a disjoint seed partition. Report calibration/discrimination and faction outcomes. If the empirically calibrated model still fails to beat fixed baselines, treat SecretMafia as a poor substrate for this SCK version rather than adding more handcrafted rules.

Q5.decision: Demote the current action_regret metric to a diagnostic and rename it if necessary to avoid implying true sequential regret.
Q5.reason: Its oracle scores immediate target correctness and ignores downstream coordination, information value, tie mechanics, and future responses. Round 5 demonstrates that it can improve while terminal play becomes much worse. Mafia-eliminate regret is also structurally non-discriminating under the current legal-action filter.
primary_metrics: paired cross-play terminal utility / faction win rate against fixed opponents
belief calibration and Brier/log loss on held-out episodes
belief-discrimination flat fraction / entropy change after informative evidence

Q6.decision: Yes, a second mixed-motive benchmark is required before step E, but do not add it until the corrected SecretMafia falsification round is complete.
Q6.reason: SecretMafia is useful as an adversarial hidden-information sanity check, but the target StoryBox use is peaceful, repeated, mixed-interest coordination. Passing only a zero-sum deception game would not validate the intended use. Conversely, adding more environments before fixing the current observation/evidence/evaluation defects would multiply ambiguity.
Q6.preferred_second_benchmark: Choose a structured, cheap TextArena mixed-motive repeated game with clear utilities and minimal dependence on an LLM listener, such as a public-goods / repeated-cooperation / structured negotiation environment. Preserve private information or conflicting incentives if available. The acceptance question is whether SCK improves decisions under partial information and long-term tradeoffs, not whether it can merely deceive better.

artifact_status_decision.supersession_rule: Do not delete either artifact. Append new artifacts from native-vote cross-play and mark those as the primary evidence for the next gate.

next_gate: Verify native day-vote observability using '[N]' through the ordinary TextArena 0.7.4 observation pipeline; do not read env backstage state for decisions.
Implement fixed-baseline paired cross-play/mixed-population evaluation with shared seeds and role schedules.
Implement a replay-calibrated symmetric evidence model using training seeds only, freeze it, and evaluate on held-out seeds.
Run a small smoke test first; if information safety, native vote visibility, and cross-play bookkeeping pass, run a larger paired experiment.
Use terminal cross-play utility/win as the primary outcome, with calibration/discrimination and leakage as mechanism gates; current action regret remains diagnostic only.
If corrected belief/belief_planning still fail against fixed baselines, stop SecretMafia tuning and declare the substrate/feature model insufficient before considering another benchmark.
Keep MCTS, bi-level search, and StoryBox/risk-list reconnection held until this gate passes.
constraints: No backstage truth reaches SCK decisions; truth may be used only in post-decision evaluation or offline calibration labels with strict train/eval separation.
No adaptation writeback into frozen history.
Do not claim an experiment passed until it was actually executed.
Do not add planner complexity to compensate for an invalid evidence channel or metric.
action_required: Honeycomb/Debus may start the next falsification round using this decision. First material delta should be native '[N]' vote visibility plus its integration test; only then modify the evidence model or run new outcome experiments.
